resources.string:
1. Open Connections and select a server. Wait for a confirmed connection.

2. On the Personal tab, tap an app and choose Clone to Pocket. Its work copy starts with separate data.

3. On the Pocket tab, tap a work app to launch it or add its home screen shortcut.

The connection continues after closing Pocket. Without a connection, the system blocks the work profile. Pausing the work profile also pauses its apps and notifications.

Removing a work copy deletes its work data. The personal copy remains.
